basis: Tennant’s February 23 results release was the earliest qualifying communication found. Its consolidated GAAP net sales table reports $291.6 million for the three months ended December 31, 2025, versus $328.9 million for the same quarter in 2024. The reported decline was 11.3%, and sales were below the $312.455 million threshold. The quarterly sales reconciliation shows zero acquisition contribution and a 2.6 percentage-point currency benefit. The November earnings call had placed the Q4 sales needed for the guidance midpoint at approximately $318 million, above the threshold.

coverage.detail: February 17, 2025. The prior-year release independently confirms the $328.9 million Q4 2024 comparison base. Its forward sales range covered full-year 2025.
April 30 Q1 release. Tennant reaffirmed its full-year 2025 outlook without providing a Q4 consolidated sales ceiling.
August 6 Q2 release. The $1.210 billion to $1.250 billion net sales range covered full-year 2025. The preceding earnings cycle yielded no qualifying Q4 sales forecast.
September investor presentation. The 3% to 5% sales target was for long-term organic growth. The slides gave no qualifying Q4 reported sales figure.

November 3 Q3 release. Tennant reaffirmed full-year net sales of $1.210 billion to $1.250 billion and reported $911.9 million for the first nine months. Subtraction implies Q4 sales of $298.1 million to $338.1 million. This annual-guidance calculation has a high end above $312.455 million.
The Q3 earnings-call slides described expected Q4 momentum and favorable currency effects. Slide 10 labels the $1.210 billion to $1.250 billion net sales range as full-year guidance.

November 4 public call, CEO Dave Huml’s response to Sidoti’s Steve Ferazani. Huml said approximately $318 million of Q4 sales would deliver the guidance midpoint. That midpoint itself exceeded the threshold. This third-party transcript records the oral remark.
February 3 Regulation FD filing. Item 7.01 set the annual meeting date and director nomination deadline. It disclosed no sales estimate.
February 13 Form 8-K exhibit. The announcement covered board appointments and a cooperation agreement with Vision One. It supplied no Q4 sales figure.

February 17 scheduling notice. Tennant announced that results would follow the February 23 market close and that the call would take place February 24. The notice contained no preliminary results. Searches for intervening issuer releases, presentations and public management updates found no earlier qualifying disclosure.
The February 23 earnings release in Exhibit 99.1 directly reports both quarterly GAAP net sales amounts and the 11.3% year-over-year decline.

publication_date_evidence: Tennant’s investor-relations results page displays 02/23/2026. Exhibit 99.1 carries the same February 23 dateline and says Tennant announced the results that day. The results call and SEC filing followed on February 24.
